questions.text: Is climate action the core purpose or goal of the policy?
questions.answer: The policy under review, Hunter's Hill Council's Sustainability Action Plan 2020, clearly identifies climate action as its core purpose. The policy acknowledges the role of every community in reducing the impact of climate change and commits to adapting existing policies and practices for more efficient use of resources. The policy outlines a range of actions and associated timeframes to lower Greenhouse Gas Emissions. It also sets a target of 100% renewable energy by 2030. The policy is designed to be a living document, reviewed and adjusted annually to take into account new ideas, technologies, and opportunities for development and delivery to the community. The policy also includes a commitment to review progress against the Action Plan and towards the Renewable Energy Target on an annual basis.
